title: Putra Mosque
visualBrief: Individual Putra Mosque: mapped square waterfront podium and separate minaret base,pink pointed arcade facades and upper abstract lattice fields,stepped pale main hall,windowed drum,large pink dome with original coarse cream diamond rhythm,eight smaller domed pavilions,bronze finials and tall tiered minaret. Historic arabesque artwork,calligraphy,furnished interiors,adjacent causeway/circulation buildings,landscaping and water surface are excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q2344561 /relation8518759 identity,anchor,undirected axis,10-vertex outer envelope and all five inner rings remain unchanged in the source record. Current named mosque POI and podium ring share id52776566652007. The large inner ring is occupied by separately mapped hall geometry and the four circular rings by mapped domed pavilions;they are not treated as open courtyards. All current parts fully inside the retained outer envelope,plus three explicit minaret controls,are selected. The minaret sits outside the square podium. Front facing,rooftop roles,arcade/lattice rhythm and exact vertical datums remain approximate. Adjacent circulation/causeway buildings remain host content.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: All original selected height/min_height tags are retained verbatim.
